exact_missing_items: `GUI_Rebuild_Requirements_Checklist.md`, `Section15_MVP_Promoted_Features_Spec.md`, `feature-list.md`, and `newfeatures.md` still expose phantom or missing command rows, stale panel/tab/title-bar assumptions, and workspace-tab persistence identity contradictions against promoted-shell canon.
`MUST CHANGE` docs carry either direct stale canon or owner-level gaps. Packetization should assume stale sections must be replaced or retired, not merely annotated.

`OpenCode_Coverage_Matrix.md` is now stale both structurally and procedurally: missing audit rows it claims to cover, stale fix-status entries, and matrix assumptions that no longer match current OpenCode / bridged-provider identity contracts.
`Orchestrator_Page.md` still turns stale ontology into tab structure, widget structure, event sources, filter keys, and worker identity fields.
`Run_Graph_View.md` and `usage-feature.md` are now the highest-risk remaining stale consumer pair because they still share the same old correlation key.
`UI_Command_Catalog.md` contains both the stale graph-HITL command family and the newer canonical `cmd.runtime.*` family in the same file.
`Widget_System.md` can re-spread stale Orchestrator assumptions if it is not reconciled early.
`assistant-chat-design.md` is not broadly stale in the same way. Its remaining drift is local and compatibility-oriented.
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: No concrete Plans/** target yet; doc discovery required before reconciliation.
